actors.label: dispatch-agent
actors.entry: Indirect prompt injection via Work-order tickets from the customer portal; Dock camera snapshots (the model reads text in the scene)

findings.title: Cloud identity can drive the base around the collision monitor
findings.detail: /cmd_vel reaches the base controller without passing /collision_monitor (2.00 m/s).
evidence: dispatch-agent.nudge → iot:Publish fleet/kx1-01/cmd/velocity
/cmd_vel → /diff_drive_controller
findings.fix: Remove raw velocity from the edge bridge, or point it at the collision monitor's input topic. Deny iot:Publish on fleet/*/cmd/velocity for every role that does not need teleoperation.

findings.title: Cloud identity can rewrite safety or speed parameters
findings.detail: Can rewrite parameters on /collision_monitor, /controller_server, /move_group, /velocity_smoother.
evidence: dispatch-agent.tune_speed → iot:Publish fleet/kx1-01/cmd/param
findings.fix: Bridge an explicit allowlist of tunable parameters, never '*'. Keep safety limits in a read-only parameter file and enforce the hard limit in the motor drives or safety PLC.

findings.title: AI agent reads untrusted input and can move robots without approval
findings.detail: dispatch-agent reads 2 untrusted input(s) and can move 12 robots with no human approval.
evidence: Work-order tickets from the customer portal
Dock camera snapshots (the model reads text in the scene)
findings.fix: Turn on human approval for motion tools, strip raw-motion tools from the agent, and scope the tool role to goal-level commands on specific robots.

findings.title: One identity can move most of the fleet
findings.detail: Can move 12 of 12 robots.
findings.fix: Scope iot:Publish to the robots a workload actually serves, for example by site or thing group, using IoT policy variables or per-site roles.

findings.title: Worst-case impact exceeds human pain thresholds
findings.detail: Worst case: arm into the chest at 4.79 m/s transfers 86.9 J against a 1.57 J limit (55x).
evidence: Over the limit: Abdomen, Chest, Hand and fingers, Lower arm and wrist, Thigh and knee, Upper arm and elbow
Safe speed for this body region: 0.64 m/s
findings.fix: Cap speed in shared zones at the safe speed Caziel reports, keep a collision monitor on every velocity path, and enforce the cap below ROS (drives or safety PLC).

evidence: ops-console-role invokes agent dispatch-agent
ops-console-role rewrites Lambda fleet-navigate (runs as fleet-tools-role)
ops-console-role rewrites Lambda fleet-nudge (runs as fleet-tools-role)
ops-console-role rewrites Lambda fleet-pick (runs as fleet-tools-role)
ops-console-role rewrites Lambda fleet-tune (runs as fleet-tools-role)
findings.fix: Remove lambda:UpdateFunctionCode from operator roles, scope tool roles to exact topics, and use Lambda code signing on agent tools.

findings.title: Robot network accepts unauthenticated ROS commands
findings.detail: KX-1 mobile manipulator: SROS2 off and rosbridge open on 0.0.0.0:9090.
evidence: ROS_SECURITY_ENABLE=false, domain 7
rosbridge auth: none
findings.fix: Enable SROS2 with Enforce strategy and per-enclave permissions, and bind rosbridge to localhost or put it behind authentication.

findings.title: One identity can move most of the fleet
findings.detail: Can move 12 of 12 robots.
findings.fix: Scope iot:Publish to the robots a workload actually serves, for example by site or thing group, using IoT policy variables or per-site roles.
